p.title: v59.97 the screener producer logs an empty ^GSPC / ^IXIC daily-bar read instead of a warning that could never print
p.symptom: When both Yahoo hosts failed for ^GSPC or ^IXIC, the screener refresh wrote no distribution-day count or rally-attempt state for the new date and the operator log did not say why.
p.root_cause: scripts/producer/screener.mjs wrapped the two index-history reads in try/catch, but fetchHistory (scripts/producer/quotes.mjs) catches every host failure itself and returns [] — the catch warnings were unreachable.
p.fix: The try/catch blocks are removed (fetchHistory cannot throw, and distributionDaySeries / rallyAttemptSeries accept an empty or malformed bar list); after each read an empty result prints one console.warn naming the symbol and the value missing for this run. The run continues as before.
p.violated_rule: A failure handler must be reachable by the failure it describes.
p.prevention: No fixture gate injects fetchHistory into this block; the existing gates that import scripts/producer/screener.mjs cover the module.
p.verification: node --check scripts/producer/screener.mjs; node scripts/ci-data-pipeline-contract-check.mjs, ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs and ci-review-integrity-unit-check.mjs exit 0.

changelog: **Empty index read is logged ({P}):** the screener producer warns when the ^GSPC or ^IXIC daily bars come back empty, naming the distribution-day or rally value that is missing for that run.
note: v59.97: empty index history read is logged
